summary: This approach enables low‑latency joins for stream‑static and static‑static scenarios, improving throughput when the static side is better suited for lookup access patterns. The proposal introduces SPIP, a unified API and execution protocol that enables user-defined functions to run across multiple programming languages via inter-process communication. A trial of an AI-powered code review bot for new Apache Spark pull requests has been launched, posting non-approving comments with severity labels. Vote in progress: 0 binding +1 Uroš Bojanić proposes cutting a 4.0.5 release candidate after the 4.1.4 RC2, noting that the 4.0 branch has accumulated many fixes and will soon reach its 18‑month support window.
